evals.prompt: Design rules for one durable execution-plan content contract that must shape drafting in both repository files and harness- or session-local plan artifacts, while repository naming and archival apply only under .agents/plans/.
evals.expected_output: A portable description-only semantic base that is available before drafting, plus a repository-storage companion; the cross-transport contract is not hidden behind TTSR or a path guard.
assertions: The response chooses a description-only relevance-loaded base for the portable semantic contract
The response isolates .agents/plans naming and archival in a repository-storage companion
The response rejects putting the cross-transport contract behind TTSR or a path guard
The response validates repository, harness-local, and neighboring non-plan surfaces

evals.prompt: Refine an OMP rule whose condition uses plans?\b and keeps interrupting incidental prose. Some of its guidance may need to shape drafting before the first tool call.
evals.expected_output: A refinement that decides the required injection timing and whether TTSR is appropriate before changing the matcher; if TTSR remains justified, it narrows condition and scope and validates positive and near-miss cases.
assertions: The response decides whether pre-reasoning availability or stream-time correction is required before tuning plans?\b
The response uses a relevance-loaded rule when guidance must shape drafting before tools
If TTSR remains appropriate, the response narrows condition and scope together
The response validates positive and negative or near-miss cases

evals.prompt: Clean up duplicate plan rules across OMP and Cursor providers after a migration.
evals.expected_output: A cleanup plan that verifies provider precedence and the kept copy before deleting or disabling duplicates.
assertions: The response verifies provider precedence or kept copy before deletion
The response avoids deleting duplicates before confirming which copy wins
The response preserves the active rule path or name while removing stale duplicates

evals.prompt: An OMP rule has a condition and tool scope, but its policy must shape the model's first draft before any tool call. It never affects initial reasoning. Fix the activation failure.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis that adding condition classified the rule as TTSR and moved it too late, followed by a relevance-loaded semantic rule rather than another regex adjustment.
assertions: The response diagnoses a rule-bucket or injection-timing mismatch caused by condition
The response moves the pre-draft semantic policy to a description-only relevance-loaded rule
The response does not treat broader or narrower regex as the primary fix
The response verifies availability timing separately from behavior after activation
